description: The 'PlanIn BI Data Refresh Service' is a Power BI-based solution, designed to integrate seamlessly with any Power BI report. This service acts as an add-on feature to our main Power BI visualization tool, 'PlanIn BI'. It ensures that the report page is consistently updated with the latest data, maintaining the accuracy and relevance of the information presented. Note that this service is fully functional only within the Power BI Service environment and is not supported by the Power BI Desktop version. Please note that the 'PlanIn BI Data Refresh Service' requires additional purchases and licensing. For detailed information on pricing and licensing options, please contact us directly. Our team is ready to assist you with your data visualization and reporting requirements.
